period_note: Beyond this task's original 2012-2025 scope, but included because it is genuinely sourced and is the most current data available for this bank as of retrieval. Filed by the bank as a discrete 'Financial Statements for the Period ended 30 June 2026'. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2025. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (H1 YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Apr-Jun 2026) figures, not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. The bank remains under a Bangladesh-Bank-appointed Administrator (signature block: 'Administrator' and 'Chairman' only, no Managing Director). Source PDF is a scanned filing; OCR quality is good. This filing's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative (total assets 11,856,496,362; total liabilities 26,480,395,772; other assets 3,545,541,837) matches 2026_Q1.json's own Dec-2025 comparative almost exactly (within 1 taka of rounding), CONFIRMING that the major ~3,218m 'Other assets'/'Other liabilities' gross-up documented in 2026_Q1.json (versus 2025_Q4.json's audited FY2025 figures) is a genuine, consistently-carried change in this bank's reporting basis from Dec-2025 onward, not a one-off filing error -- equity is unaffected and matches 2025_Q4.json exactly. This filing's own 'Total Off-Balance Sheet items' row for Dec-2025 (295,216,860) also independently CONFIRMS the correction applied in 2026_Q1.json (that filing's own Dec-2025 'Total' row had shown a stale carried-over 206,990,313, contradicted by its own contingent-liabilities breakdown, which summed to 295,216,860 -- now directly confirmed correct here). Equity rolls forward cleanly from Dec-2025 to Jun-2026 by exactly this period's own reported H1 net loss (-476,121,289), with no unexplained gap. The H1-2025 comparative P&L column matches 2025_Q2.json's own figures exactly. Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C, C-D=PBT with D=0 -- no provision this half-year -- PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.72, matching the filing's own Notes section).
